messages:
sara: Heads up — found a partner service token in a debug log export from last night. Not public yet, exposure window ~3h. Starting containment and rotation plan here.

kai: thanks. can you paste the log line (sanitized) and which env/service? need scope/blast radius.

sara: sanitized: "partner-token=***REDACTED*** service=ingest-pipeline env=staging path=/var/log/ingest/worker.log" — staging only AFAICT. partner id 0x34b.

chris: ok. immediate actions: 1) ask partner to revoke token 2) revoke any Vault bindings that reference it 3) schedule svcacct/keypair rotation. treat as high priority.

sec-oncall: on it. initiating audit export for last 24h for reads of /secrets/partners/34b.

sara: filing incident ticket and pinging partners@ for attest. incident id SEC-2025-089.

kai: RBAC Q — ingest-pipeline had a transient role allowing cross-namespace read for log-shipper. revoke now or rotate first?

chris: revoke role immediately. keep record so we can reapply with narrower perms after rotation. also set vault proxy audit-log-level=debug for 2h to watch attempts.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: applied policy change to k8s rolebinding logship-ingest-staging by sara @ 1738200123 :white_check_mark:.

sec-oncall: audit export queued. found 2 reads of /secrets/partners/34b from svcacct=ingest-writer @ 1738199900 and 1738200010 — suggests the token was used by the writer.

anna: if ingest-writer had access we need to rotate both partner token and svcacct keypair. rotation plan: - partner creates new token and uploads to onboarding endpoint - create new k8s secret for ingest-writer - deploy via canary - monitor auth errors and rollback if needed.

kai: about KMS wrapping: are partner tokens Transit-wrapped in Vault? if so rewrap ciphertext to a new KMS key version instead of recreating raw ciphertext.

chris: they are TLS-wrapped via Vault transit. plan: create new alias key in KMS, rewrap ciphertext to new key, then rotate transit key version in Vault. still ask partner to rotate their token as primary containment.

sara: partners asked to rotate immediately — ETA ~2h, uploading to onboarding endpoint.

sec-oncall: proposed priority queue: [critical revokes/role revokes] > [rewrap ciphertext & rotate svcacct] > [deploy canary & monitor] > [audit re-run + postmortem]. owners: revoke=sara, rewrap=chris, deploy=anna, audit=kai.

kai: need rollback plan if canary fails: 1) reapply old rolebinding + old secret 2) short-lived traffic split 3) if persistent failure, cut traffic to fallback region. set short TTL on new secrets until validated.

anna: monitoring: add alert sec.token-usage-high for >5 auth errors/min post-rollout. I'll add grafana panel for ingress auth failures.

sara: running rotation script for svcacct now. snippet:
```
# rotate svcacct secret
kubectl -n staging delete secret ingest-writer-secret || true
kubectl -n staging create secret generic ingest-writer-secret --from-literal=token=$(generate_new_key)
kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingest-worker
```

chris: rewrap started: calling KMS rewrap API and stashing new ciphertext at vault path /secrets/partners/34b/rewrapped_v2. kms req id: kms-req-98321.

sec-oncall: audit re-run will check for any reads after 1738200200. hold rebinds until 1738200300 so we have a clean window.

monitor-bot: added alert sec.token-usage-high in #eng-security by anna @ 1738200220 :rotating_light:.

sara: partner confirmed rotation at 1738200290 and uploaded new token to onboarding endpoint. pulling and validating now.

anna: canary shows 0 auth errors in last 10m. increasing traffic to 25%.

kai: post-rotation checklist: update runbook with timeline, note RBAC gap (logship role too broad), propose default policy: disallow cross-namespace secret reads.

chris: rewrap complete. switched vault alias to new ciphertext at 1738200330. archived old ciphertext for 24h.

sara: marking SEC-2025-089 contained at 1738200345. scheduling postmortem meeting tomorrow. thanks all.

sec-oncall: tidy-up tasks to backlog: revoke archived ciphertext after 24h, run RBAC policy audit, update onboarding validation to reject plaintext tokens in logs. will close thread when postmortem doc is up.

sara: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
